fix(click): every leaf row states how many arguments its verb reads, and a refusal counts for the session that clicked (brandon-menus-sjhy.vxi)

From the medium review of PR #658:

- The leaf table carries each verb's arity, and the one step runner
  refuses a link carrying more, so no fixed-arity verb acts with a tail
  dropped unread. This replaces the session-only wrapper, which covered
  only some of the verbs. Verbs whose arguments are lists (set-state pairs,
  reset-config keys) read any number.
- A refused step is counted for the session that clicked, never for a
  session id a step's link spelled, so no page can put refusals on a
  session it chooses.
- The drawn-link reader's comments claim only how a link reads, leaving
  per-step refusals to the daemon.

Deferred to brandon-menus-sjhy.ovq: the double read of a click, the
session it reads twice, and the one-element read list a direct leaf
click builds.

fix(click): a leaf's arguments are decoded once by its click's reader, and a verb that takes its session alone refuses a tail (brandon-menus-sjhy.vxi)

From the high review of PR #658:

- The reader splits a leaf's value before decoding it, so an empty last
  argument is still one: a copy of empty text copies it again.
- Handlers take their arguments decoded, so no handler repeats the decode,
  and the run refusal line names the action as the config does, not
  percent-encoded.
- toolbar-toggle, back, rewind, apply-update, doctor-run, save, save-preset,
  save-theme-default, undo and redo refuse a tail through one wrapper rather
  than dropping it unread.
- A step refused because its click's own session failed says so, instead of
  claiming it names another session.
- The click line always carries sid: the session that passed, or `-`.
- Wire decoding parses to a result once (parseWire); the throwing form is
  built on it, so the session reader no longer converts the error twice.

Not taken: mirroring per-step refusals in the drawn-link reader, which
reads parse-level refusals only; a second copy of the cross-session rule
there would be a second enforcer. The double read of a click is
brandon-menus-sjhy.ovq.

fix(click): a leaf verb receives its click's session parsed, and a step naming another session is refused (brandon-menus-sjhy.vxi)

Every leaf handler now takes (sid: SessionId, args, ctx). One reader reads a
leaf effect: its first segment through the one session-id checkpoint, and the
encoded tail after it. It never throws, so a later step's malformed session is
that step's refusal, held on the bar. perform, the one runner every leaf
passes through, refuses a step whose session fails the checkpoint or is not its
click's. So a dispatch can no longer act on one session and report to
another's bar, and a verb with no session cannot join the leaf table.

perform hands each refused step to its verb's refusal owner. The run stats
count a run link refused at its session as they count one refused for its
arguments. The run handler's own catch is gone, so that count lives in one
place.

Every leaf verb's value is now segments, its session first, so the link
reader decodes by the leaf table and the separate segmented-verbs list is
deleted. The per-handler session re-parse, the copy/open session reader and
the first-segment decode helper go too.

A leaf click with an empty session segment now reads as a failed session, not
as a click naming none, so its reply facts carry no sid.
fix(draw): a frame's lanes are noted before its walk, so a frame that throws still says which lanes it drew for (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.0se)
refactor(draw): a view's draw returns the lane switches it drew under; two comments name lane frames (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.0se)

fix(facts): a replay draws the lane feeds and diagnostics the live draw was handed, and the frames a lane drew (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.0se)

A replay drew every frame with every lane idle, no open viewer, and only
the request answers, so a recording of a session with a lane following or
the warnings viewer open replayed a bar the user never saw.

- A draw line is one draw of the view, an answer or a lane's frame: it
  carries the instant it was drawn at and what it was handed (who it drew
  for, each lane's feed, the diagnostics list). A lane's frames write the
  view's frame memory and the session's effect memory, so the recorder
  notes each one, to every recording of the session, and the replay draws
  them in the file's order at their exact instants. RECORDING_VERSION 6.
- The daemon and the demo draw a view through one function (draw-view),
  which derives every draw projection from what the draw was handed and
  stands the open viewer in for the bar. The demo's own drawDsl call goes.
- A recording that holds only lane frames is kept and replays; `record`
  reports answers and lane frames.
- The seam test's live side is the daemon's draw throughout, and a new case
  replays a standing warning, a following lane, its toggles and the open
  viewer, compared whole.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(band): a switched-off band lane holds no follower process (candybar-animation-wbxz.w33)

The band mod stops its follow child on the daemon's SWITCHED_OFF answer
instead of keeping it alive to re-ask every 5s, and turning band (A) off
uninstalls the mod so sessions started afterwards never load it. An
uninstall of a mod that is not installed is the state off asks for, so it
is said rather than thrown.
